name: toucher
behavior: creates glitched floor tiles that slow the player and lock abilities while they stand on them; its body kills instantly on contact; an audio cue plays whenever new glitched tiles appear. Avoid the glitched zones entirely.
counter_play: keep off its floor, keep height between you (it rises 2.0 u/s at most; you jump 2.25 u in 0.375 s), and hurdle it on a path — its 1.4 u body meets a clean jump with 0.85 u to spare at apex (SR-2). Its glitched tiles invalidate the newest safe-tile ring entries, so a void dive near it respawns you farther back — a real cost, and the tip text says so.
tell: it infects all tiles within 3 u below it (squelch cue when new tiles appear)
